image_description: A low-angle interior shot of a grand, ornate Baroque-style high altar within a church. The structure features massive twisted columns (Solomonic columns), a central niche containing a statue, and elaborate gilded detailing. A smaller, simpler table altar with a white cloth is visible in the immediate foreground at the base of the main structure. The background shows a vaulted ceiling with a dome and windows.
